units.locator: Beginning of document
units.text: In accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation and Federal Law No. 58-ФЗ of 27 May 2003 ‘On the System of State Service of the Russian Federation’ (hereinafter the Federal Law ‘On the System of State Service of the Russian Federation’), this Federal Law establishes the legal, organizational, financial and economic foundations of the state civil service of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Beginning of document · “In accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation…”

units.locator: Chapter 1. GENERAL PROVISIONS
units.text: Chapter 1. GENERAL PROVISIONS
units.label: Chapter 1. GENERAL PROVISIONS

units.locator: Article 1. Basic terms
units.text: Article 1. Basic terms
units.label: Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic terms
units.text: For the purposes of this Federal Law, the terms used mean:
units.label: Art. 1 · “For the purposes of this Federal Law, the terms used mean:”

units.locator: Article 1. Basic terms
units.text: 1) state offices of the Russian Federation and state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation (hereinafter also state offices): offices established by the Constitution of the Russian Federation and federal laws for the direct exercise of the powers of federal state bodies and public authorities of a federal territory, and offices established by constitutions (charters) and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for the direct exercise of the powers of state bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic terms
units.text: 2) employer's representative: the head of a federal state body, a public authority of a federal territory or a state body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, a person holding a state office, or a representative of such head or person, exercising the employer's powers on behalf of the Russian Federation, a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or a federal territory;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic terms
units.text: 3) professional level: the level of knowledge and skills necessary to perform official duties possessed by a citizen seeking a position in the federal state civil service or the state civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, a federal state civil servant or a state civil servant of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation (hereinafter also a civil servant);
units.label: Point 3 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic terms
units.text: 4) assessment of professional level: determination of the level of knowledge and skills necessary to perform official duties possessed by a citizen seeking a position in the state civil service of the Russian Federation (hereinafter also a civil service position) or by a civil servant;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic terms
units.text: 5) field of professional service activity: the set of tasks, powers and functions of federal state bodies, public authorities of a federal territory and state bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation (hereinafter state bodies), and of persons holding state offices of the Russian Federation or of its constituent entities, towards whose implementation the performance of civil servants' official duties is directed;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic terms
units.text: 6) type of professional service activity: specialization in particular tasks, powers and functions of a state body within a civil servant's field of professional service activity.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 2. Subject matter regulated by this Federal Law
units.text: Article 2. Subject matter regulated by this Federal Law
units.label: Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. Subject matter regulated by this Federal Law
units.text: This Federal Law regulates relations connected with entry into, performance and termination of the state civil service of the Russian Federation and with determination of the legal position (status) of a civil servant.
units.label: Art. 2 · text

units.locator: Article 3. State civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 3. State civil service of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. State civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. The state civil service of the Russian Federation (hereinafter also the civil service) is a type of state service consisting of the professional service activity of citizens of the Russian Federation (hereinafter citizens) in civil service positions to support the exercise of the powers of state bodies, persons holding state offices of the Russian Federation and persons holding state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. State civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. The state civil service of the Russian Federation is divided into the federal state civil service (hereinafter also the federal civil service) and the state civil service of constituent entities of the Russian Federation (hereinafter also the civil service of constituent entities of the Russian Federation).
units.label: Part 2 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the civil service
units.text: Article 4. Principles of the civil service
units.label: Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the civil service
units.text: The principles of the civil service are:
units.label: Art. 4 · “The principles of the civil service are:”

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the civil service
units.text: 1) priority of human and civil rights and freedoms;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the civil service
units.text: 2) unity of the legal and organizational foundations of the federal civil service and the civil service of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the civil service
units.text: 3) equal access to the civil service for citizens who know the state language of the Russian Federation and equal conditions of service regardless of sex, race, ethnicity, origin, property or official status, place of residence, attitude to religion, beliefs, membership of public associations or other circumstances unrelated to a civil servant's professional qualities;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the civil service
units.text: 4) professionalism and competence of civil servants;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the civil service
units.text: 5) stability of the civil service;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the civil service
units.text: 6) accessibility of information about the civil service;
units.label: Point 6 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the civil service
units.text: 7) interaction with public associations and citizens;
units.label: Point 7 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the civil service
units.text: 8) protection of civil servants against unlawful interference in their professional service activity.
units.label: Point 8 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. Relations connected with the civil service are regulated by:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1) the Constitution of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2) the Federal Law ‘On the System of State Service of the Russian Federation’;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3) this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 4) other federal laws, including federal laws regulating specific features of civil service;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 5) decrees of the President of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 6) resolutions of the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 7) normative legal acts of federal executive bodies;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 8) constitutions (charters), laws and other normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 9) normative legal acts of state bodies;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 10) normative legal acts of public authorities of federal territories.
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. If an international treaty of the Russian Federation establishes rules different from those provided for by this Federal Law, the rules of the international treaty apply.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3. Decisions of interstate bodies adopted on the basis of provisions of international treaties of the Russian Federation interpreted in a manner contrary to the Constitution of the Russian Federation are not enforceable in the Russian Federation. Such a contradiction may be established in the manner determined by federal constitutional law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 6. Relationship between the civil service and other types of state service of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 6. Relationship between the civil service and other types of state service of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Relationship between the civil service and other types of state service of the Russian Federation
units.text: The relationship between the civil service and other types of state service of the Russian Federation is ensured on the basis of the unity of the state service system of the Russian Federation and the principles of its structure and operation, and through:
units.label: Art. 6 · “The relationship between the civil service and other types of…”

units.locator: Article 6. Relationship between the civil service and other types of state service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1) comparability of the basic conditions and levels of remuneration and basic state social guarantees;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Relationship between the civil service and other types of state service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2) establishment of restrictions and obligations in the performance of different types of state service of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Relationship between the civil service and other types of state service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3) taking account of service in other types of state service of the Russian Federation when calculating civil service length;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Relationship between the civil service and other types of state service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 4) comparability of the basic conditions of state pension provision for citizens who have performed state service of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 7. Relationship between the civil service and municipal service
units.text: Article 7. Relationship between the civil service and municipal service
units.label: Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Relationship between the civil service and municipal service
units.text: The relationship between the civil service and municipal service is ensured through:
units.label: Art. 7 · “The relationship between the civil service and municipal…”

units.locator: Article 7. Relationship between the civil service and municipal service
units.text: 1) uniform basic qualification requirements for civil service and municipal service positions;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Relationship between the civil service and municipal service
units.text: 2) uniform restrictions and obligations in civil service and municipal service;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Relationship between the civil service and municipal service
units.text: 3) uniform requirements for training personnel for the civil service and municipal service and for the professional development of civil servants and municipal servants;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Relationship between the civil service and municipal service
units.text: 4) taking account of municipal service length when calculating civil service length, and civil service length when calculating municipal service length;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Relationship between the civil service and municipal service
units.text: 5) comparability of the basic conditions of remuneration and social guarantees for civil servants and municipal servants;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Relationship between the civil service and municipal service
units.text: 6) comparability of the basic conditions of state pension provision for citizens who have performed civil service and citizens who have performed municipal service, and for their families in the event of loss of a breadwinner.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 7
